# incident_access_group (Data Source)

Manage access groups: named groups of users that access grants give privileges to. Membership is managed in the dashboard or through SCIM.

Use this data source to look up an access group by `id` or by `slug`. Set exactly one of the two. This is how you refer to the base groups every organization has, whose slugs are `owner`, `admin` and `standard`, or to a group created in the dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a base group by its slug: every organization has owner, admin and standard.
data "incident_access_group" "admin" {
  slug = "admin"
}

# Or look up any group by ID.
data "incident_access_group" "platform" {
  id = "01G0J1EXE7AXZ2C93K61WBPYEH"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this access group
- `slug` (String) Stable identifier, unique within the organisation. Base groups use owner, admin and standard. Generated from the name when omitted on create, and cannot be changed later.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description of who belongs in this group
- `name` (String) Human-readable name, unique within the organisation
- `type` (String) base for the groups every organisation has, which cannot be changed or deleted, or custom for groups you create. Possible values are: `base`, `custom`.
